newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mostly firmer, fuel oil tight.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mostly firmer, fuel oil tight.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were firmer on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline was up $3 or so as tight supplies and surging NYMEX prices hit the market. Dealers said there were only two or so cargoes seen available for August.

A Turkish buy tender for 25,000 tonnes to be delivered by August 14-16 was announced today. The tender closes on August 4 and intense competition is expected for the two Romanian cargoes deemed most suitable.
Med fuel oil markets were balanced to tight, with Tuesday's purchase of Russian cracked fuel to meet bunker needs in Las Palmas having eased some buying pressure.
The buyer paid $99 cif for Baltic port material.
An Italian buyer was still looking on the scanty bunker scene for barrels, but what little is available appears to be poor quality.
Cracked Black Sea M100 was to be found more freely and one percent was under pressure from better avails in the North and weak interest from the major Italian buyer.
Gas oil prices firmed across the board, with August IPE last traded $3.25 stronger at $171.00 a tonne.
Discussions on the physical market were desultory.

Buyers argued premiums are artificially high, inflated by sellers' exaggerations about the extent of Greek spot demand at a time when the only consistent requirement in the region is for modest inventory building.
Italian heating oil was offered at fob Med high +$3.50. Russian heating oil was bid at cif high Med +$1.50 but aroused no interest.
